verify-before-using-ledger-facts.text: The client accepts a commitment under its own policy and checks the intended NFT state. Changed bytes, identity, root or network must never become accepted facts.

keep-dependent-reads-coherent.text: Reads and pagination remain at one selected state while new blocks arrive. Unavailable and expired checkpoints are refused. Fork behavior remains to be decided.

add-an-application-without-another-chain.text: An application reconstructs state from transactions and historical inputs. Its result must match the authenticated application root. Missing history is a failure, not an empty successful answer.

delegate-proof-construction.text: Clients can ask an application service to construct proofs and verify them locally, or perform the construction themselves. Authority stays with the same accepted root.

publish-trust-without-serving-queries.text: An anchor runs a node and computes signed commitments for each block. It does not have to retain historical query views. No institution is assumed to provide this service.

evidence-status.text: These stories are acceptance targets. No formal model, simulator or production conformance result has yet been delivered.

act-on-verified-facts.text: A terminal verifies the facts needed for its application, then builds a transaction or drives an external effect. Its application policy authorizes that action; a proof alone is not an instruction to act.

Ledger proofs are checked off-chain and are not placed in transaction redeemers. Application proofs are placed in redeemers. Cardano checks actual ledger validity, and application validators check the application proofs.
